title: E-Quiz on Current Affairs by ECE Department
content:
E-Quiz on Current Affairs by ECE Department

ATME College of Engineering is celebrating its decennial year, on account of this Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering is organizing E-Quiz on Current Affairs for students.

Importance of Quiz: A quiz is a game which can be called as a mind sport. Quizzes improve and expand one’s knowledge of things, either general or in specific area. Quizzes are designed to promote, a fun way to study and in the process that improve one’s general knowledge. Being fun to participate in but with a competitive element. Quiz competitions even help to build the student’s soft skills.

E-certificates will be provided to the participants those who score above 50% and above

Date: 28th May 2021

Time: 4.00 PM to 6.00 PM

Who can enroll? : Students

Registration link: https://forms.gle/MqAC9QdJq5xrHP4h8
